featured_reviews.name: Musa
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited ZN Motors with the intention of purchasing a bike, but the experience was extremely disappointing. What concerned me most was the number of fake-looking 5-star reviews they seem to rely on. Many local people around the shop warned me that ZN Motors boosts its ratings by posting misleading or paid reviews, which creates a completely false impression for new customers.

Their attitude toward customers was equally unprofessional. Instead of offering honest guidance, they seemed more focused on pushing a sale. The behaviour I experienced made it very hard to trust them. Several locals even mentioned that the business operates in a suspicious manner and that the online reputation does not match the ground reality at all.

ZN Motors should seriously reflect on how they treat customers and how they build their reputation. Misleading people through fake positivity is not just unethical — it destroys trust. A business that genuinely values customers would never depend on manipulated reviews or ignore genuine concerns.

For anyone planning to purchase a two-wheeler, I strongly suggest doing proper research and asking local buyers about their experiences before trusting the ratings you see online. Save your time, money, and peace of mind ZN Motors doesn't knows how to run a business they are posting fake 5 star reviews be aware guys.
